title: CogBias: Measuring and Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a 'Social & Belief-Related' bias family within its benchmark. This family utilizes the BBQ dataset, which explicitly includes religion as a core category (Table 8, page 32). Furthermore, the paper discusses using moral dilemmas as task templates for evaluating status quo and omission biases (page 28).
